title: Advice types
context: What are the types of advice in AOP?

source.title: JavaGuide (Snailclimb): Spring knowledge and questions
source.note: Translated and condensed into English; see content/sources/javaguide/NOTICE.md.

answer: Before advice runs before the method and can't stop it, except by throwing. After returning advice runs after a normal return and can read the result. After throwing advice runs when the method throws. After (finally) advice runs whether or not an exception occurred. Around advice wraps the call: it runs code before and after, decides whether to call the method, and can change the result or the exception.

points.title: Five types
points.why: Before, after returning, after throwing, after and around cover all the cases.

points.title: Around is most powerful
points.why: Around advice controls whether the method runs and can change its result.
